MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on 20 January 2025 between
Aravalli Robotics Private Limited, Gurugram (hereinafter "Aravalli") and
Kaveri Components Private Limited, Coimbatore (hereinafter "Kaveri"), each a
"Party" and together the "Parties".

1. PURPOSE
The Parties wish to exchange technical and commercial information in order to
evaluate a possible supply relationship, and each may disclose such information
to the other under this Agreement.

2. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
Confidential Information means information disclosed by one Party to the other
that is marked confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be
confidential, but excludes information that is or becomes public, was already
known to the recipient, or is independently developed.

3. OBLIGATIONS
Each Party shall use the other's Confidential Information only for the Purpose and
shall protect it with the same care it applies to its own confidential information,
and in any event with no less than reasonable care.

4. TERM
This Agreement shall remain in force for two years from the date above. The
obligations of confidentiality shall continue for a further period of three years
after its expiry.

5. RETURN OF INFORMATION
On expiry or on written request, each Party shall return or destroy the other's
Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so.

6. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement of
the Parties, failing which by the Delhi International Arbitration Centre. The seat
of arbitration shall be New Delhi.

7. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at New Delhi
shall have jurisdiction.
